text_block_list.text:
One day, when I entered the library,
a stack of old racing books sat in the corner of a desk.
And beside it stood a flustered Umamusume……

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No... way...
You're... kidding, right...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: To throw away all these books...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher-Librarian
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, the library weed-out has been finalized...
We have new books coming in, and with limited space,
it's simply inevitable...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-But...
Once paper documents are lost...
we may never encounter them again...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...
I know it's not my place to interject, but...
Um......
choice_data_list: It really is a shame, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...!
Y-You truly think so...?
Still... hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
............
U-Um... in that case――!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *whew*...!
Um... Thank you so much.
For helping me... carry these...
choice_data_list: Something like this is no big deal!

text_block_list.text:
To my astonishment, she offered to take in every single historical document about to be thrown away.
Every last bit of this colossal mountain of material...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...
...I just couldn't bring myself
to turn a blind eye...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That history... might come to an end...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
These are all precious historical documents...
If they were to be lost or scattered, we'd never be able to replace them...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even when covering the same race,
books from different eras reveal perspectives
of the time that data alone cannot measure...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It is precious "history"...
Books compiled with conviction and accountability
are the very crystallization of wisdom and thought...!

She seemed quiet and like a model student,
but deep down, she harbored
a burning passion for the history of racing...
choice_data_list: Don't overdo it—let's take breaks while carrying them.
Your drive to learn is incredible.
Your passion for learning is really something else.

text_block_list.text:
She seemed quiet and like a model student,
but deep down, she harbored
a burning passion for the history of racing...
choice_data_list: Don't overdo it—let's take breaks while carrying them.
Your drive to learn is incredible.
Your passion for learning is really something else.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you for your concern...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Phewww...
Thanks to you, we managed to finish carrying everything...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much for today.
For a passerby to show me such kindness... I am truly humbled...
choice_data_list: I'm just glad we could protect those precious historical records.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, y-yes...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Great history ought to be preserved for future generations……
Right……?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much... truly.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: N-No, no... not at all...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Learning... well, it's more like...
I love it, so I just want to know more...
That's really all there is to it...

—And so, chatting intermittently,
we went back and forth between the library and the dorm,
finishing the transport of all historical documents.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so, so much...
You really saved me...
choice_data_list: Likewise, I'm just glad we could protect the books.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, er...
Are you interested in those kinds of books too,
Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like,
I'd be happy to lend it to you anytime...
